verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design properly for the banner. The headline sits on one large line and dominates, and it reads left to right from the logo to the product. However, 'Full review inside.' is a tiny three-line stack jammed against the circle and the right edge, the NEW VIDEO pill is cramped under the logo, and the logo hugs the left edge. B squeezes the headline into three tiny lines that fill the full banner height. Its subcopy is minuscule, the NEW VIDEO badge collides with the lime circle, the circle touches the top and bottom edges, and about 220px on the right is left empty, so the weight is lopsided.
